name: Affirmative Solutions
old_description: With combined decades of experience, our team is here to help you find the tools you need to get the job done.
about:
Affirmative Solutions, LLC operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders. Its website emphasizes a team with combined decades of experience dedicated to helping customers find the tools they need for fabrication and manufacturing projects. The site lists a phone number (505‑244‑4073) and business hours of Monday through Friday 7 am to 6 pm, with Saturday appointments available.

The business positions itself as a source for steel fabrication, manufacturing, and job-shop services. It describes its offerings as products and services that the team would use on its own projects, suggesting a practical, hands-on approach. No details on facility size, headcount, production volumes, or part numbers are provided.

The company does not list specific industries or customer types on its website. Its messaging is broad, targeting anyone with steel fabrication, manufacturing, or job-shop needs. The site includes a customer review section and an email sign‑up for updates.

Affirmative Solutions highlights its identity as builders and workers, stating that its products and services are what they would use on their own projects. This practical, user-focused philosophy is presented as a key differentiator, along with the team’s combined decades of experience.
